decisions.reason: As the core software platform for GIS solutions, it is central to the firm's announced direction and has received high investment and public commitment, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
Mobile field data capture is strategically important and publicly presented, and the resources already invested justify persistence despite any disappointing results.
Although a more peripheral extension, the firm has publicly committed to version updates and invested in its development, so escalation of commitment still makes dropping unlikely in the near term.
